_howto: Owner-editable announcement feed. The app fetches this fresh on every cold start (web + native) — edit, commit, push; NO Play rollout needed. Each message shows once per device (tracked by id). Fields: id (required, unique, never reuse), enabled (set true to go live), title, body (array of plain-text paragraphs — HTML is NOT rendered), cta_label + cta_url (optional button, https only), cta_action (optional: "backup-first" makes the button open the Move to the iPhone app sheet in a browser, which asks for a CSV download before the link; older builds and the store apps just open the link), platforms (optional, any of: "android" and "ios" for the store apps, "web" for any browser, "web-apple" for a browser on an iPhone, iPad or Mac), minVersion/maxVersion (optional APP_VERSION range, e.g. only nudge old builds), starts/ends (optional ISO dates for a time window).

messages.title: Sample announcement

messages.title: Duitful is on the App Store
body: The iPhone app backs up to your own iCloud, encrypted first. Back up now is free; Pro does it automatically.
Your data here lives only in this browser and the app starts empty, so save a copy first. The button walks you through it.
